profile: single-engine ULTRA, YOCO140, BF16 growable cache, 49152 primary sweep, 61440 fold cap
input: repeated frozen ANYGGUF recall-token body, without a semantic recall check

runs.prefill_seconds_scope: legacy alias for launch-to-ready TTFT; startup included
runs.prompt_clock_definition: Native sequential embedding_40_layers_head clock: all prompt sweeps, token preparation and between-sweep ownership admission through synchronized frontier logits. Initial model open/allocation, final bulk export/certification, recall and decode excluded. Early Engram prefetch can overlap initial open.
runs.ttft_clock_definition: Host ComboProducer launch boundary through frontier READY: process startup, model open/allocation, prompt processing, final state certification and IPC included; external harness prechecks, recall and decode excluded.
runs.overhead_definition: TTFT minus prompt interval; includes setup and post-head certification/IPC, not just process startup.
